name: Magalu
description: Magalu Marketplace (Magazine Luiza) seller API: orders and deliveries with NF-e, shipping and delivery confirmation, SKUs with prices and stock, processing traces, categories, customer questions, chat and SAC tickets. Sign-in with ID Magalu (OAuth2).
instructions:
## Magalu
This connector works with the **Magalu Marketplace seller API** (API Magalu) of Magazine Luiza, Brazil, at `https://api.magalu.com` (questions and chat at `https://services.magalu.com`): orders and their deliveries (packages) with NF-e, shipping and delivery confirmation, the SKU portfolio with prices and stock, processing traces, categories, customer questions, chat and customer service (SAC) tickets.

**Setup (about 15 minutes)**
1. Sign in at https://id.magalu.com with the ID Magalu account of a legal representative of the store (only they can grant consent for the store).
2. Create an OAuth client, either in the console at https://developers.magalu.com/clients or with the `idm` CLI (github.com/luizalabs/id-magalu-cli): `./idm login`, then `./idm client create --name "AnythingMCP" --redirect-uris "https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback" --audience "https://api.magalu.com https://services.magalu.com" --scopes "<scopes>"`. On a self-hosted server use `<your server URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback`. The audience must include `https://services.magalu.com`, or questions and chat answer 401. Add the scopes listed in the connector's OAuth settings; some (scores, for example) need approval by Magalu.
3. Copy the **Client ID** into `MAGALU_CLIENT_ID` and the **Client Secret** into `MAGALU_CLIENT_SECRET`. The secret is shown only once.
4. Install, click **Authorize with Provider**, sign in and choose the store (tenant) on the consent page. Access tokens last up to 2 hours and are renewed with the refresh token.

**Where to start**: `magalu_get_seller` returns the channel id (needed by every price, stock, SKU and delivery write) and the tenant id. Then `magalu_list_orders` (status approved for paid orders) or `magalu_list_deliveries` (status approved: to invoice and ship) and `magalu_get_order` or `magalu_get_delivery`.

**Orders and deliveries**: an order has one or more deliveries; invoicing and shipping happen per delivery. Flow for sellers shipping themselves: `magalu_add_delivery_invoice` (44-digit NF-e key plus the XML; SEFAZ validates it, see `magalu_list_delivery_invoices`; fix an invalid one with `magalu_replace_delivery_invoice`), `magalu_ship_delivery` (carrier, tracking code and URL), then `magalu_mark_delivery_delivered`, which **cannot be undone**. `magalu_list_delivery_history` shows the steps. In delivery writes the channel id is the order's `channel.id`. Check `handling_time.limit_date` (UTC; the Seller Portal shows Brasília time, so dates may look a day apart). `magalu_generate_shipping_labels` (Magalu Entregas labels) is installed switched off. There is no seller cancellation endpoint: cancellations arrive as status cancelled or as SAC tickets of type cancellation.

**Portfolio (asynchronous)**: `magalu_list_skus`, `magalu_get_sku`, `magalu_create_sku`, `magalu_update_sku`; prices with `magalu_get_price`, `magalu_set_price` (first price) and `magalu_update_price`; stock with `magalu_get_stock`, `magalu_set_stock` (first stock) and `magalu_update_stock` (`magalu_list_warehouses` gives distribution-centre ids for multi-origin sellers). Every write answers 202 with a trace_id: read the outcome with `magalu_list_traces` (code = your SKU) or `magalu_get_trace`. `magalu_get_sku_validation_info` explains a blocked SKU. Categories: `magalu_find_categories`, `magalu_list_category_hierarchy`, `magalu_list_category_attributes`, `magalu_list_category_datasheet`.

**Money**: amounts are integers with a `normalizer` (100 = cents) in BRL: price 9990 means R$ 99,90. The connector always sends currency BRL.

**Questions and chat**: `magalu_list_questions` (WAITING_RESPONSE = open), `magalu_get_question`, `magalu_answer_question` (moderated before publication). Chat: `magalu_list_conversations`, `magalu_get_conversation`, `magalu_list_conversation_messages`, `magalu_send_conversation_message`, `magalu_mark_conversation_read`.

**Customer service (SAC)**: `magalu_list_tickets`, `magalu_get_ticket`, `magalu_list_ticket_messages`, `magalu_list_ticket_events`, `magalu_list_ticket_returns`, `magalu_send_ticket_message`. SAC writes answer 202 with a transaction id: `magalu_list_transactions` and `magalu_get_transaction`. Installed switched off: `magalu_create_ticket` (cancellation or shipping tickets), `magalu_create_ticket_return` (reverse shipment) and `magalu_create_ticket_event` (return steps). The connector cannot authorise refunds.

**Paging and limits**: lists take `offset` and `limit` (`_offset`, `_limit`; most at most 100, offset up to 5,000 rows) and answer `meta.page` plus `results`. Dates are ISO 8601 in UTC. Rate limits per seller and minute: orders and deliveries 850, SKU create 650 and read 550, prices 850, stock 650 writes, questions 200 reads and 50 writes, chat 200 reads and 50 writes, SAC tickets 100. A 429 means wait and retry.

**Writes: confirm first.** Invoices, shipping, delivery confirmation, prices, stock, SKU changes and messages act on the live store. Before each call show the user what will change and wait for a yes.

MAGALU_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
MAGALU_CLIENT_ID.help: Create an OAuth client at developers.magalu.com/clients or with the idm CLI (idm client create), with the redirect URI of this server and the audience https://api.magalu.com https://services.magalu.com. Copy the Client ID.
MAGALU_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the Client ID only, without spaces.

MAGALU_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client secret
MAGALU_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Shown once when the client is created. If it was lost, reset it in the console or create a new client.
MAGALU_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the client secret without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Magalu refused the token. Click Authorize with Provider again and choose the store on the consent page. For questions and chat the client's audience must include https://services.magalu.com.
verifyHints.403: The token lacks the scope for this call. Add the scope to the client (idm client add-scope or the console), then authorize again so the consent page shows it; some scopes need Magalu's approval.
verifyHints.404: Magalu found no order, delivery, SKU, question or ticket with that id.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Magalu limits each seller per minute (orders 850, SKU reads 550, questions 50 writes). Wait a minute and try again.

prerequisites: A Magalu marketplace seller account and an ID Magalu account of a legal representative of the store, who creates an OAuth client (developers.magalu.com or the idm CLI) and grants consent for the store. Some scopes need Magalu's approval. About 15 minutes.

tools.name: magalu_get_seller
tools.description: Read the seller behind the token: tenant id (GENPUB.…, needed by magalu_get_sku_validation_info), channel id and name (needed by every price, stock, SKU and delivery write) and seller id and name. Costs one cheap read; use it first.

tools.name: magalu_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the distribution centres enabled for the seller (Magalu Entregas multi-origin): id, name, display_name and active. The id goes into branch of the stock tools.

tools.name: magalu_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, oldest first by default: id, code, status, purchased_at, approved_at, updated_at, channel, customer (name, document number, email, phones), amounts (total, freight, discount, commission, as integer plus normalizer), payments and deliveries. status approved also returns invoiced, shipped and delivered orders. Paged with offset and limit.

status.description: new (created), approved (paid; also invoiced, shipped, delivered), cancelled (all deliveries cancelled) or finished.

code.description: Only the order with this code.

purchased_from.description: Purchased at or after, ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

purchased_to.description: Purchased at or before, ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

updated_from.description: Updated at or after, ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

updated_to.description: Updated at or before, ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

offset.description: Rows to skip (_offset, default 0). Magalu pages up to an offset of 5,000 rows.

limit.description: Rows per page (_limit, default 20, at most 100).

tools.name: magalu_get_order
tools.description: Read one order by its code: status, dates, customer, amounts, payments and its deliveries (packages) with their ids. Ship, invoice and finish each delivery separately.

code.description: Order code on Magalu (`code` of magalu_list_orders).

tools.name: magalu_list_deliveries
tools.description: List deliveries (packages; one order can have several): id, status (new, approved, invoiced, shipped, delivered, cancelled, frozen), items with SKU, quantity and unit price, shipping provider, recipient, handling_time limit_date (UTC), tracking_url, invoices and the order code and channel. Paged with offset and limit.

code.description: Only deliveries of this order code.

purchased_from.description: Purchased at or after, ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

purchased_to.description: Purchased at or before, ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

offset.description: Rows to skip (_offset, default 0). Magalu pages up to an offset of 5,000 rows.

limit.description: Rows per page (_limit, default 20, at most 100).

tools.name: magalu_get_delivery
tools.description: Read one delivery: items (sku, quantity, unit_price), shipping (provider, recipient and address, deadline, handling_time limit_date, tracking_url), invoices, returns, shipped_at, delivered_at and order code and channel id.

delivery_id.description: Delivery (package) id: `deliveries[].id` of magalu_get_order or `id` of magalu_list_deliveries.

tools.name: magalu_list_delivery_history
tools.description: Read the status history of a delivery: created_at and description of each step, oldest first by default.

delivery_id.description: Delivery (package) id: `deliveries[].id` of magalu_get_order or `id` of magalu_list_deliveries.

offset.description: Rows to skip (_offset, default 0). Magalu pages up to an offset of 5,000 rows.

limit.description: Rows per page (_limit, default 20, at most 100).

tools.name: magalu_list_delivery_invoices
tools.description: List the NF-e invoices attached to a delivery: key, issued_at, status (validating, approved, invalid) and xml.

delivery_id.description: Delivery (package) id: `deliveries[].id` of magalu_get_order or `id` of magalu_list_deliveries.

offset.description: Rows to skip (_offset, default 0). Magalu pages up to an offset of 5,000 rows.

limit.description: Rows per page (_limit, default 20, at most 100).

tools.name: magalu_list_skus
tools.description: List your SKUs: sku, title, brand, status (PUBLISHED, UNPUBLISHED, BLOCKED, UNDER_REVIEW, DELETING, DELETED), active, group, channels, created_at and updated_at. Default 10 per page, at most 100.

group_id.description: Only SKUs of this variation group.

offset.description: Rows to skip (_offset, default 0). Magalu pages up to an offset of 5,000 rows.

limit.description: Rows per page (_limit, default 10, at most 100).

tools.name: magalu_get_sku
tools.description: Read one SKU: title, description, brand, status, active, category, channels, attributes, datasheet, dimensions, identifiers (EAN), images, group and url_marketplace.

sku.description: Your SKU code (up to 32 characters), as used when the SKU was created.

tools.name: magalu_get_sku_validation_info
tools.description: Read why a SKU is blocked or flagged by Magalu's publication policies: the latest block or alert with errors (action, message, rules).

sku.description: Your SKU code (up to 32 characters), as used when the SKU was created.

tenant_id.description: Tenant id of the store (`tenant.id` of magalu_get_seller, e.g. GENPUB.…); sent as X-Tenant-Id.

tools.name: magalu_get_price
tools.description: Read the prices of a SKU per channel: price and list_price as integers with normalizer (100 = cents) and currency.

sku.description: Your SKU code (up to 32 characters), as used when the SKU was created.

tools.name: magalu_get_stock
tools.description: Read the stock of a SKU per channel and distribution centre: quantity and type (AVAILABLE, RESERVED).

sku.description: Your SKU code (up to 32 characters), as used when the SKU was created.

tools.name: magalu_list_traces
tools.description: List the processing results of asynchronous writes (SKU, price and stock), newest data per SKU: code, severity, origin context and resource, message and created_at. Filter by your SKU in code.

origin_resource.description: Resource, e.g. skus, prices or stocks.

app_trace_id.description: trace id returned by a write (trace_id).

offset.description: Rows to skip (_offset, default 0). Magalu pages up to an offset of 5,000 rows.

limit.description: Rows per page (_limit, default 50, at most 100).

tools.name: magalu_get_trace
tools.description: Read one processing result (trace) of an asynchronous SKU, price or stock write in detail by its id: severity, origin, message and dates.

tools.name: magalu_find_categories
tools.description: Find a Magalu category by id or by name (at least 3 letters): id, name, parent and path.

name.description: Part of the category name, at least 3 characters.

offset.description: Rows to skip (_offset, default 0). Magalu pages up to an offset of 5,000 rows.

limit.description: Rows per page (_limit, default 50, at most 100).

tools.description: Browse the category tree: root categories (root_only), one category with its whole subtree (category_id), or the direct children of a category (parent_id).

category_id.description: A category and all its descendants.

parent_id.description: Only the direct children of this category.

tools.description: Change the price and list price of a SKU in a channel, integers in cents (normalizer 100) in BRL. Asynchronous: answers 202 with a trace_id.

tools.name: magalu_set_stock

tools.name: magalu_answer_question
tools.description: Answer a customer question. The answer goes through Magalu's moderation before it is public (status APPROVED or RESPONSE_REJECTED). Answers 202.

owner_name.description: Name of the person or system answering, as shown to Magalu (e.g. the store name).

owner_id.description: Your own id for the author (e.g. the agent's user id in your ERP).

external_id.description: Your own id for this answer (optional).

tools.name: magalu_send_conversation_message
tools.description: Send a message to the customer in a chat conversation (at most 2,200 characters). Answers 201.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id (24 hex characters, `id` of magalu_list_conversations).

owner_name.description: Name of the person or system answering, as shown to Magalu (e.g. the store name).

owner_id.description: Your own id for the author (e.g. the agent's user id in your ERP).

external_id.description: Your own id for this message (optional).

tools.name: magalu_mark_conversation_read
tools.description: Mark a chat conversation as read by the seller, so it no longer counts as unread in the Magalu seller tools. No body is sent.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id (24 hex characters, `id` of magalu_list_conversations).

tools.name: magalu_send_ticket_message
tools.description: Send a message in a SAC ticket to the customer, to Magalu (channel) or as a seller note (at most 3,000 characters). Asynchronous: answers 202 with a transaction_id (magalu_get_transaction).

owner_name.description: Name of the person or system answering, as shown to Magalu (e.g. the store name).

owner_code.description: Your own id for the author.

tools.name: magalu_create_ticket_event
tools.description: Record a return step on a SAC ticket: product_sent, return_info_sent (return label sent to the customer) or product_received (returned item arrived). Refund authorisation is deliberately not offered. Installed switched off.

tools.name: magalu_create_ticket
tools.description: Open a SAC ticket for an order delivery: a cancellation request or a shipping problem, with the items concerned. A cancellation cannot be taken back. Installed switched off.

channel_id.description: Channel id (UUID): `channel.id` of magalu_get_seller, or `order.channel.id` of the order for delivery writes.

delivery_id.description: Delivery (package) id: `deliveries[].id` of magalu_get_order or `id` of magalu_list_deliveries.

items.description: Items: `[{"id": "item id", "sku": "SKU-1", "quantity": 1}]` (item id from the delivery).

tools.name: magalu_create_ticket_return
tools.description: Request a reverse shipment (return code) for a SAC ticket; Magalu Entregas then collects the item from the customer. Installed switched off.

tools.name: magalu_generate_shipping_labels
tools.description: Generate Magalu Entregas shipping labels for deliveries: answers a signed_url to the PDF or ZPL file and its expiry. Labels are tied to Magalu's logistics contract. Installed switched off.
